newsitem.title: USA: Abacus Direct names Carlos Sala as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Abacus Direct names Carlos Sala as CFO.

text.p: Abacus Direct Corp, said Monday it has named Carlos Sala as senior vice president-finance, chief financial officer, effective May 19.
Sala replaces Karl Friedman, who previously announced he is leaving Abacus to pursue other interests, the company said.
Sala will hold the additional titles of corporate secretary and treasurer, it said.

Prior to joining Abacus, Sala was executive vice president - chief financial officer at Dal-Tile International Inc Previously, Sala was a mergers and acquisitions manager at Ernst & Young in New York.
Abacus developed and manages the nation's largest proprietary database of consumer catalog buying behavior used for target marketing purposes.
